Subbaiya vs The Commissioner on 5 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/70257494/ 
1  Sivagangai District forthwith by considering petitioner's representation  12.11.2024.
 For Petitioner : Mr.R.Paranjothi  for M/s.KBS Law Office  For Respondents : Mr.D.Gandhi Raj  Special Government Pleader for R1  : Mrs.M.Aasha  Government Advocate (Crl.Side) f  ORDER This writ petition has been filed for a direction directing the respondents to remove the lock and seal of the petitioner's tea shop at Aaravayal village, Devakottai Taluk, Sivagangai District. 
2. Heard the learned counsel appearing on either side and perused the materials placed before this Court.
3. The petitioner is running a tea stall situated at Aaravayal village, Devakottai Taluk, Sivagangai District. While being so, the fifth respondent conducted inspection and found that the petitioner is selling Cigarette and other tobacco products, without any licence. Therefore, an F.I.R has been registered as against the petitioner in Crime No.91 of 2024 for the offence under Section 24(1) of C i g a r e t t e a n d o t h e r T o b a c c o P r o d u c t s A c t , 2 0 0 3 . S u b s e q u e n t l y , t h e https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis petitioner admitted his guilty and he paid fine. Thereafter, the second respondent came to the petitioner's shop and lock the petitioner's tea stall premises by putting seal and also affixed the order dated 30.10.2024.
4. On perusal of the order dated 30.10.2024, it revealed that the petitioner's licence was cancelled temporarily until further orders. Sofar no complaint has been laid before the adjudication officer to adjudicate the issue. 
5. In view of the above, the second respondent is directed to file a complaint before the adjudicating authority within a period of two weeks from the date of receipt of copy of this order. After the complaint of the adjudication proceedings, the second respondent is directed to consider the representation submitted by the petitioner, to remove the lock and seal of the petitioner's shop and also issuance of licence.
6. With the above direction, this writ petition is allowed. No costs.
